title: chore(spec): refresh api-surface snapshot for aggregation-policy exports (#2208 follow-up)
body:
Fast follow-up to #2208. That PR added three `@objectstack/spec/data` exports (`defaultAggregateFor`, `isIncoherentAggregate`, `MEASURE_FIELD_TYPES`) but did not regenerate the committed public-API-surface snapshot, so the `check:api-surface` gate is red on `main`.

This regenerates `packages/spec/api-surface.json` via `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec gen:api-surface`. Intentional addition — **0 breaking, 3 added**; check is green again.
